reviewed_sources.finding: No operative product-level copayment percentage, trigger, or non-application rule was identified. Page 44 contains only a generic moratorium caveat that policies remain subject to limits, sub-limits, co-payments and deductibles as per the policy contract.

candidate_findings.finding: The Co-Payment row provides only the generic definition and no populated Tata-specific amount, percentage, trigger, or clause. Nearby rupee values belong to deductible/other-limit content and are not attributable to copayment.
The moratorium section generically states that policies remain subject to co-payments and deductibles as per the policy contract; it does not establish an operative product-level copayment rule.

repeatability_classification.reason: The reviewed primary-legal wording and corroborating CIS are insufficient to determine an affirmative product-level copayment fact. Existing runtime is not the blocker; authoritative evidence is insufficient to support a percentage-bearing obligation, explicit non-application rule, or authoritative absence claim.
